about_the_game:
🧠 OVERVIEW

The world didn’t die quietly.
First came the panic. Then the rot. Then everything fell apart.

In End of Everything, you’re dropped into the ruins of a collapsed world where the infected roam freely, resources are scarce, and survival is never guaranteed. Cities are abandoned, the land is unforgiving, and whatever caused the outbreak left scars — and secrets — buried deep within the environment.

This is a first-person survival game focused on long-term endurance, scavenging, crafting, base building, and discovery. Zombies are everywhere — not in waves, not on a timer — but as a constant threat you must fight through, avoid, or out think while learning how the world truly fell.

Survive. Scavenge. Build. Explore. Adapt.
The world won’t explain itself — you have to earn the answers.

🔑 WHAT TO EXPECT

  • The saving/loading of game state is currently missing in both singleplayer/multiplayer due to Netick Unity integration. Witch includes buildables inventory storage and world states. This will be fixed in update 0.2.1.

🎮 First-Person Survival Gameplay

Immersive FPS survival where positioning, ammo management, and awareness matter more than raw firepower. Every fight drains resources, attracts attention, and forces hard decisions — fight, flee, or prepare better next time.

🧟 A Persistent Infected Threat

There are no “rounds” here.

The infected exist throughout the world at all times, occupying structures, roads, and points of interest. Survival means clearing areas carefully, securing routes, and learning when to engage and when to avoid conflict.

Hidden across each map are Easter egg–style secrets and environmental quests, inspired by classic COD Zombies–style discoveries. Players who explore, experiment, and pay attention will uncover deeper layers of the world — and the truth behind it.

⚒️ Survival Systems That Matter

Survival goes beyond combat.

Hunger and thirst must be managed through scavenging, hunting, and preparation.
Stamina affects movement, combat, and escape.
Weight limits force meaningful inventory and loadout decisions.
Health reflects long-term survival, not just moment-to-moment damage.

These systems demand planning, restraint, and adaptation.

Early Access Note: Progression systems are planned for future updates, allowing players to upgrade and specialize survival stats through leveling and long-term play.

🏗️ Base Building & Crafting

Create safety in an unsafe world.

Gather materials from the environment to craft weapons, tools, consumables, and equipment. Establish shelters or fortified bases to store supplies, plan expeditions, and defend your resources.

Base building and crafting systems will continue to expand throughout Early Access, with additional structures, recipes, and defensive options added over time.

🌦️ Environment, Sky & Weather Improvements

The environment itself is part of the challenge.

Major improvements to lighting, sky systems, and weather effects dramatically change visibility, atmosphere, and tension. Harsh sunlight, dust-filled winds, night darkness, and environmental conditions directly impact how you explore, fight, and survive.

🤝 Multiplayer Survival

Play solo or survive alongside others in online multiplayer.

Scavenge together, build shared shelters, explore dangerous locations, and push deeper into hostile territory. Cooperation improves survival chances — but resources are limited, and every decision matters.

There are no second chances once you go down.

🌍 THE WASTELANDS — MAP UPDATE 0.2.0

New Map: Wastelands (Demo)

A massive 3 km² desert-style map inspired by post-apocalyptic wastelands similar to Fallout: New Vegas.

What You Get:
A huge, meticulously optimized open-world demo map designed for survival gameplay.
25+ diverse buildings including houses, shops, warehouses, and industrial locations — all with interiors.
Over 700 environmental objects such as furniture, debris, fences, wreckage, and world details.
Wide-open desert terrain combined with dense points of interest filled with danger and hidden secrets.

This map serves as both a playable survival experience and a foundation for future expansion.

🌑 EARLY ACCESS NOTICE

End of Everything is currently in Early Access

The game is actively in development and not yet feature-complete.
Gameplay systems, balance, content, and mechanics may change significantly.
Bugs, performance issues, and incomplete features should be expected.
Save data may be reset or wiped during major updates.

The estimated development timeline from Early Access to full release is approximately 2–3 years.

By purchasing and playing during Early Access, you are supporting ongoing development and helping shape the future of the game.

🌍 A WORLD AFTER EXTINCTION

This isn’t the apocalypse — it’s what comes after.

Every location in End of Everything is handcrafted to deliver atmosphere, tension, and environmental storytelling. The deeper you explore, the more you’ll realise the outbreak wasn’t random — and survival alone won’t reveal the full truth.

Survive long enough to uncover what remains.

content_descriptors.notes:
Apocalypse Survival Sandbox includes mature content that players should be aware of:

Violence: The game features frequent depictions of realistic violence, including blood, bodily injury, and death. Players engage in combat with zombies, alien invaders, and hostile survivors using melee and ranged weapons.

Horror Elements: Expect very frightening scenes and psychological horror, creating a tense atmosphere.

Language: There's occasional mild profanity, swearing, and cursing throughout the game, with some moderate crude language and occasional swearing.

Mature Themes: The storyline and gameplay involve survival in a harsh post-apocalyptic world, which includes environmental hazards and severe weather conditions.

Legal Drugs: The game includes implied use of alcohol or tobacco, as well as the use of alcohol or tobacco and the use of medical drugs in an unapproved manner.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon RX 480 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: In End of Everything, survive a first-person world overrun by the infected. Look for supplies, craft weapons and tools, build shelters, and explore a hostile wasteland filled with secrets, hidden quests. Play solo or team up in multiplayer, and adapt to survive in a world that refuses to stay dead.
